changedBehavior: Resolve an owned IPv4 address from its exact local adapter before neighbor/ARP data, keeping unusable local MACs unknown and preserving remote resolution.
expectedAssertions: A conflicting neighbor MAC cannot override the exact owning local adapter, including when other adapters are enumerated first.
Empty, zero, multicast, broadcast and non-six-byte local MACs remain unknown without consulting the remote resolver.
Unavailable adapter metadata remains unknown rather than falling back to potentially conflicting neighbor data.
Nonlocal addresses invoke the existing remote resolution path exactly once and preserve its MAC or unknown result.
